about.name: Amanda Gratwick
about.p1: We spend our childhood being told to colour inside the lines, but through life I've discovered that all the best stuff happens when you venture outside the lines. I’m Amanda Gratwick, the maker behind Outside The Lines Studio, based in Sandbanks where I spend my life either in the ocean or recreating it in different forms in my studio, bringing a little bit of the wild and peace that the roll of the ocean provides.
about.p2: As a graphic designer in a world of AI I was looking for somewhere tangible to turn, something real I could hold in my hands and say I made. I love the sea, it is my place to escape and think, whether that's floating on a flat calm surface or kitesurfing in a wild and stormy environment, I find it grounding and it was in the sea I realised that I could bring an essence of this home and into my studio.
about.p3:
I make serving boards, platters, coasters and wine glasses by hand, all lines are available in my ocean range and a select few pieces are also available in my mountain and lava ranges. All the wooden boards are made from olive wood, perfect for serving food as it has a naturally occurring antibacterial property and is absolutely beautiful! Every item has two resin pours and no two pieces are the same. I let the grain of the wood and the pour of the resin decide how the water will flow, sometimes coating the edges, sometimes leaving a clean wooden finish all the way round. And if you are looking to finish the gift off I also draw ocean based greetings cards for the full sea worthy package.

I hope you enjoy discovering my site and my products, if you have questions feel free to message me and I will do my best to answer! Also if the boards I produce aren't quite what you're looking for and you have a particular shape or size in mind please contact me to discuss a custom piece.

And don't forget to take a peak outside the lines, you might just like what you find!

ordering.intro: Every piece is handmade to order from the options you choose.

steps.title: Choose a piece
steps.text: Browse the shop and pick the type, shape, size and range you like, then choose resin edges or clean edges.

steps.title: Buy or place an order

hero.eyebrow: Handmade in olive wood and resin
hero.lead: Beautiful serving boards, platters, coasters and wine glasses in Ocean, Mountain and Lava ranges. Choose an item, the range and your edge finish and rest assured no one will ever have an piece like it.

faqs.a: Choose a piece, pick your size and edge finish (resin edges or clean edges), then press Order this piece. We email you a secure payment link and post your piece once it is paid.
Yes. Every piece is handmade, so the timber, the colours and the shape of the resin change from one to the next. The pictures on the site are illustrations of each type.

faqs.q: What are the two types of resin finish?
faqs.a: Resin edges: the resin runs down the sides of the piece as well as through the middle, so the colour wraps right round the edge. Clean edges: the timber edges stay natural all the way round and the resin is kept to the surface. You choose between the two from the Edge finish drop-down on each board and platter.
